messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD Alert #INC-8473 - ap-southeast LB target unhealthy + TLS handshake errors > 5% over last 3m. Impact: ~10% traffic to ap-southeast degraded.

pagerduty-bot: Alert routed to oncall:liam. Auto-escalation in 3m.

liam: acked. I'm on it. grabbing logs and health metrics.

sara: seeing the same in Datadog, spike in 525 / TLS_alert_handshake from edge-frontend-ap. Also Route53 queries show increased NXDOMAIN? weird.

matt: NXDOMAIN sounds bad — can you paste `dig +short our-app.example.com @8.8.8.8`?

liam: run and paste... (runs) `dig` shows two IPs: one healthy in us-west, one pointing to old ALB in ap-southeast that we decommissioned last month

emily: that old ALB still has an expired cert. If traffic is routed there by DNS, we'd see TLS errors.

liam: looks like a DNS propagation issue — customers hitting ap-southeast are getting stale record from old host. TTL is 300 but someone rolled it to 3600 last week? checking Route53 change history.

devops: I see a change: hosted zone change id CHZ-2222 by infra-deploy 2 days ago — they bumped TTLs during zone cleanup. Rollback attempt now.

liam: temporary mitigation: add weighted routing to shift traffic away from ap-southeast ALB to us-west. `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://shift.json` prepping file.

matt: also open a support ticket to certificate manager and request immediate cert rotation? Might be faster to remove old ALB from DNS.

sara: current customer impact: Auth errors and 502/525 for sessions initiated in ap-southeast. Severity P2, product says low revenue impact but major latency for APAC dev customers.

pagerduty-bot: INC-8473 acknowledged by liam at 3250004330.

liam: deployed change: `shift.json` applied — weights 90% us-west, 10% ap-southeast. give 30s to propagate.

emily: checking edge logs — TLS errors drop by 60% for new connections. Old sessions still failing.

matt: Can we TTL flush at registrar? Not possible. But we can add HTTP redirect at old ALB to a maintenance page while we rotate cert.

devops: I can attach a temporary cert to old ALB from cert-manager (self-signed) and respond 503 with Retry-After. Will do now.

devops: done — old ALB responding 503 + Retry-After header, TLS handshake now succeeds. New TLS errors gone.

sara: Datadog graphs show 525 dropped near zero, latency normalizing. Customers reporting fewer errors.

liam: I'm going to escalate to oncall lead to coordinate rollback of the TTL change. pinging @emily (oncall lead).

emily: on it. We should plan: 1) keep weight shift for 1hr 2) schedule TTL rollback to 300 3) schedule postmortem to track why TTL was bumped.

liam: update: PagerDuty notifications suppressed for 15m to avoid noise. manual follow-ups only.

pagerduty-bot: Notifications suppressed for INC-8473 by liam for 15 minutes.

matt: Customer comms draft: short status to affected customers in APAC, mention temporary routing and mitigation, ETA for fix 1h. I'll draft.

sara: any secondary causes? Could old ALB auto-register via terraform state drift? file a ticket to infra-deploy to audit.

devops: created ticket INFRA-983 with details. assigned to infra-deploy.

liam: handoff to emily for next hour. I'm going offline in 5m. emily, take ownership.

emily: ack. taking ownership. will monitor for next 90m and run rollback at +60.

liam: thanks. logging timeline and tags into incident tracker.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8473 status update: Mitigation in place — 90% traffic routed to us-west, old ALB serving 503; monitoring shows TLS error rate returned to baseline. Severity lowered to P3. Next: TTL rollback and postmortem.

emily: closing loop — any customers to notify directly? matt please post the comms and cc success team.

matt: posted in #customer-impact with draft. tagging support.

sara: note for postmortem: add to RCA that TTL changes must route through change-control and include a verification playbook. Also add 'zone-cleanup' job owners.

emily: noted. I will own the PM and schedule postmortem for tomorrow. If nothing regresses, I'll resolve the PD alert.

incident-bot: INC-8473 will auto-resolve after 2h if no new alerts.
